verdict.rationale: TruffleHog Enterprise offers hosted and self-hosted scanners that store findings in a web UI, so data retention and deletion is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion controls, or data-lifecycle policy. Choosing self-hosted deployment is an adjacent deployment option, not a retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
